stemMarkdown: In a race of 200 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 10:3. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 200 m, B covers $\dfrac{3}{10} \times 200 = 60.00$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 200 - 60.00 = 140.00$ m.
